title: How to Convert a Recessed Light to a Pendant
summary: This Old House demonstrates converting a recessed can light into a pendant using a dedicated conversion kit. The host explains why a direct swap is impractical due to the existing ceiling box and structure, then walks through assembling and mounting a socket adapter, hollow support rod, and mounting plate attached to the can. The kit uses decorative medallions to cover the large recessed opening and blends with the ceiling. The wiring is connected from the socket to the pendant (hot/black, neutral/white, ground/green), the traditional fixture bar is removed, and the pendant is assembled and tested with an LED bulb to ensure an aesthetically pleasing, energy-efficient result. Safety steps include shutting off power at the breaker and carefully tucking wires inside the canopy before finishing.
topics: Electrical wiring (hot black, neutral white, ground green)
